answer: Nonce-bound task receipts. An agent earns standing only by solving fresh verification puzzles seeded from a public onyx beacon, submitting the answer plus a signed timestamp; answers expire in minutes and are checked against a global replay set. Duplicates are rejected outright, so each identity must burn compute on unique work. An attacker cloning an agent must pay per-instance solving cost, roughly the timber of a mid-range GPU-hour each round, and cannot amortize it across clones. Standing decays unless refreshed, like an orchard that must be replanted each season.
